uutiset.t: Trump faces backlash after saying he 'convinced' Nvidia to reinstate CEO Jensen Huang
uutiset.s: Nvidia had come under pressure from President Trump to reappoint Huang, whose comeback helped add $1tn to the company's stock value.

uutiset.t: Watch: Moment troops raid home and capture Mexican drug lord
uutiset.s: Newly-released bodycam footage shows the moment troops detained 'El Chapo Isidro', who had managed to evade capture for years.

uutiset.t: DR Congo says aircraft missing as rebels claim to shoot down plane
uutiset.s: A South African fighter pilot and a Ugandan officer are reportedly among those aboard the downed plane.

uutiset.t: What Jensen Huang's return teaches China's Xi about Trump
uutiset.s: Huang being back at the helm of Nvidia is no guarantee of relief for Beijing.

uutiset.t: Bangladesh's ex-PM Sheikh Hasina says she plans to return on 16 December
uutiset.s: Hasina has spoken several times of her desire to return, but this is the first time she has set a date.

uutiset.t: India's 'cockroach' party leader says he was stopped from flying to UK
uutiset.s: Saurav Das said that immigration authorities at Delhi airport told him that his passport had been "flagged".

uutiset.t: Nato chief vows defence against space threat after Russian nuclear satellite reports
uutiset.s: German media said Russia planned to launch a satellite with a nuclear warhead into space in coming weeks.

uutiset.t: Cheers and applause as Jensen Huang returns to Nvidia office
uutiset.s: BBC's Lily Jamali reports from Nvidia's headquarters, where she gauges the reaction to Huang's return after Trump says he brokered a deal.

uutiset.t: King Charles and Elton John pay tribute to Australian music legend Molly Meldrum
uutiset.s: The promoter and broadcaster helped define the music tastes of Australians for decades.

uutiset.t: Dad who discovered daughter's murder on Facebook feels ignored by South African police
uutiset.s: South African communities tell the BBC of measures they're taking to keep women safe after a wave of horrific killings.

uutiset.t: Outrage after ICE arrest father and daughter at Seattle airport
uutiset.s: ICE officers arrested two passengers, a father and daughter, as they were boarding a flight in Seattle on Saturday.

uutiset.t: Gisèle Pelicot 'humiliated' after nude photos sent to media to promote book
uutiset.s: The publisher of an essay on coercive control apologises for "an unfortunate and inappropriate communication".

uutiset.t: UK sanctions top Myanmar military leaders after Rohingya genocide ruling
uutiset.s: The UK is joined by several other nations in recognising an ICJ ruling that Myanmar carried out genocide.

uutiset.t: What strike on Russian ship in Libya says about spread of Ukraine war
uutiset.s: Ukraine's sinking of a Russian battleship at a port in Libya raises the stakes of the war a notch, writes Frank Gardner.

uutiset.t: First Lady Melania Trump welcomes this year's White House Christmas tree
uutiset.s: The official 2026 White House Christmas tree is an 18-foot fir from Silent Night Evergreens, a farm in Endeavor, Wisconsin.
